# Vendored reference engine snapshots

These archives are source-oriented snapshots of the two pinned reference engines. They exclude Git metadata, installed dependencies, generated build output, and large media assets. See `docs/REFERENCE_ENGINES.md` for upstream URLs, exact commits, licenses, and reproducible checkout commands.

- `openhands-software-agent-sdk-source.tar.gz`
- `opendesign-source.tar.gz`
